answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely verified enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and a hardware-backed attestation key. Copying a virtual-machine image cannot reproduce that binding: a sybil identity requires an independently attested enclave running the authorized code, so expanding the identity set requires purchasing physical silicon rather than duplicating software. Names such as copper, voyage, and jetty therefore carry no authority without valid attestation.
